_comment: Operator-verified YouTube playlist ids used as a curated discovery source (PLAN-ADDENDUM §34 correction 14). Entries are added by a human AFTER verifying the id resolves, because a fabricated id silently 404s and wastes a quota unit. The file starts empty on purpose: the app must run without it.

_format.id: the YouTube playlist id, e.g. PLxxxxxxxx
_format.label: a human-readable name shown in the UI as the source
_format.genre: the genre/topic this list stands for
_format.verifiedAt: ISO date the id was last verified
